positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.description:
As part of the Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) project worked on a Data Pipeline using AWS Serverless architecture. Made use of AWS SDK, CLI and APIs. Used CloudFormation, API Gateway, Lambda, Kinesis, S3, CloudWatch, Cognito, IAM, Websocket, etc. The Pipeline is used internally by NASA and externally by NASA partners to submit data about flights for multiple uses, including storage/processing/ETL in NASA hosted databases, distribution for use by visualization tools.
Collaborated with customers (NASA Civil Servants) and NASA partners to both use and define/refine requirements of the Data Pipeline products.
Participated in multiple Flight Events, monitoring flights using both real and simulated vehicles.
Created the Monthly Progress Reports for my team.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
A primary software developer of the UAS Traffic Management (UTM) system, starting near its inception. Developed the server side with RESTful API design using Java, Spring Boot, Maven, Gradle, PostGIS, ActiveMQ, and other Apache technologies.
Worked on a NUSS Operation Planner used with UTM and later Urban Air Mobility (UAM), developed in Python.
Created and maintained Continuous Integration (Jenkins) jobs and executed deployments of UTM.
Used Test Driven Development (TDD), Git/Github/Bitbucket for version control.
Wrote documentation in Swagger, Atlassian Confluence, readme files, etc. Tracked tickets in Atlassian JIRA. 
Frequently ran Sprint Planning meetings. Interfaced with customers to get requirements.
Collaborated with other internal teams. Worked with partners to verify compatibility of their product with UTM/UAM software and as support during flight tests and demonstrations.
Mentored and lead new software engineer recruits. Interviewed new prospective engineers.
Often tasked with creating Monthly Progress Reports for the team.
Transitioned to development of Data Pipeline project for UAM using Java and then AWS Serverless architecture.
